errors.network: Ntitwashoboye kugera kuri MediLink. Reba niba murandasi ikora, wongere ugerageze.
errors.rateLimited: Wagerageje inshuro nyinshi. Tegereza amasegonda {{seconds}}, wongere ugerageze.
errors.rateLimitedNoTime: Wagerageje inshuro nyinshi. Tegereza umunota umwe, wongere ugerageze.
errors.sessionExpired: Igihe cyawe cyarangiye. Ongera winjire kugira ngo ukomeze.

validation.codeRequired: Andika kode y’imibare 6 iri muri porogaramu yawe yo kwemeza
validation.recoveryCodeRequired: Andika imwe muri kode zawe zo kugarura konti

brand.description: Kwakira abarwayi, kwisuzumisha, farumasi no kwishyura mu kigo cyawe, ahantu hamwe hatuje.

login.title: Injira muri MediLink
login.invalidCredentials: Imeyili cyangwa ijambo ry’ibanga si byo. Bisuzume wongere ugerageze.
login.patientHint: Urashaka kwivuza? Abarwayi bakoresha porogaramu ya MediLink.

mfaSetup.title: Shyiraho kwinjira mu ntambwe ebyiri
mfaSetup.intro: Konti z’abakozi zisaba intambwe ya kabiri mu kwinjira kugira ngo amakuru y’abarwayi arindwe.
mfaSetup.step1Title: 1. Shyira porogaramu yo kwemeza muri telefoni
mfaSetup.step1Body: Urugero Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator cyangwa indi porogaramu ya TOTP, kuri telefoni ukoresha wenyine.
mfaSetup.step2Title: 2. Sikana iyi QR kode ukoresheje iyo porogaramu
mfaSetup.qrLabel: QR kode yo kongera konti yawe ya MediLink muri porogaramu yo kwemeza
mfaSetup.manualKeyLabel: Ntushoboye gusikana? Andika uru rufunguzo muri porogaramu
mfaSetup.codesTitle: Bika kode zawe zo kugarura konti
mfaSetup.codesIntro: Niwatakaza telefoni, buri kode igufasha kwinjira rimwe. Zibike ahantu hizewe, kure ya telefoni yawe. Ntituzongera kuzikwereka.
mfaSetup.savedConfirm: Nabitse kode zanjye zo kugarura konti ahantu hizewe
mfaSetup.printTitle: Kode zo kugarura konti ya MediLink za {{email}}

mfaVerify.title: Andika kode yo kwinjira
mfaVerify.intro: Fungura porogaramu yawe yo kwemeza, wandike kode y’imibare 6 ya MediLink.
mfaVerify.codeHint: Shyiramo cyangwa wandike kode. Imyanya irimo nta kibazo.
mfaVerify.useApp: Koresha kode iri muri porogaramu yanjye
mfaVerify.recoveryIntro: Andika imwe muri kode zo kugarura konti wabitse igihe washyiragaho kwinjira mu ntambwe ebyiri.
mfaVerify.recoveryHint: Urugero abcd-1234. Buri kode ikora rimwe gusa.

facility.title: Hitamo ikigo cyawe
facility.intro: Ukora mu bigo birenze kimwe. Hitamo aho ukorera ubu. Ushobora guhindura igihe icyo ari cyo cyose uhereye hejuru.

palette.title: Shakisha cyangwa ujye kuri
palette.noResults: Nta murwayi uhuye na byo kuri iki kigo

placeholder.title: {{section}}
placeholder.body: Iki gice kizakorwa mu cyiciro gikurikira.
placeholder.heading: {{section}} biraje vuba

notFound.title: Iyi paji ntibonetse
notFound.body: Reba aderesi, cyangwa usubire kuri paji y’Uyu munsi.

forgot.title: Hindura ijambo ry’ibanga
forgot.intro: Andika imeyili y’akazi. Niba ifite konti, tuzakoherereza ihuriro ryo gushyiraho ijambo ry’ibanga rishya.
forgot.sentBody: Niba hari konti ya {{email}}, ihuriro ryo guhindura riroherejwe. Rikora iminota 30.

reset.title: Shyiraho ijambo ry’ibanga rishya
reset.hint: Nibura inyuguti 12. Interuro ngufi yoroshye kwibuka kandi igoye gukeka.
reset.doneBody: Ijambo ry’ibanga ryahinduwe kandi wasohowe ahantu hose. Injira ukoresheje ijambo ry’ibanga rishya.
reset.invalidLink: Iri huriro ntiryuzuye. Ongera ufungure ihuriro riri muri imeyili, cyangwa usabe irindi.
